cohort: 706 pregnant women with COVID-19 and 1424 pregnant women without COVID-19 from 43 institutions in 18 countries
finding: COVID-19 diagnosis during pregnancy is associated with increased risks of maternal complications such as preeclampsia/eclampsia, severe infections, ICU admission, and mortality, as well as neonatal complications such as preterm birth, severe neonatal morbidity, and perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of neonatal COVID-19 positivity, while breastfeeding was not.
